title: A Young Protector Defies Mir Mannu's Elephant

blocks.text: To shield the hidden women, the young religious leader publicly claims one woman as his sister and another as his daughter, while declaring the others members of his own following. By accepting that burden himself, he tries to stop Mir Mannu’s officers from exposing the Sikhs through further interrogation or assault.

Mir Mannu orders the youth to be crushed by an elephant, but the beast instead touched his feet with his trunk and refused to carry out the execution. Even a second attempt fails, turning the scene into another testimony of moral courage and failed royal violence.

Mir Mannu’s wife then persuades him to spare several captured Singhs, but the reprieve is short-lived. New intelligence soon leads the searchers to a large field overgrown with sugarcane, where yet another group of Singhs, including women, children, and elders, is surrounded.
